scope: Finite read-only classification of the 13 intermediate mismatches retained in docs/V2_M2A_TRAJECTORIES.json.
method: Used existing trajectory mismatch summaries and raw retained snapshots only. For each mismatch, the before reference is the first retained observation at the immediately preceding world tick (same-tick duplicate polls are skipped, matching the report's selection rule); after is the retained observation at the mismatch sequence. No simulator comparison was rerun and no after-state was used as an input.

interpretation.observed: At each mismatch boundary, the observed signature contains a new visible force absent from the immediately preceding retained world-tick observation. The source tower's observed unit vector has lost the force's reported unit counts, while the model-predicted source tower retains those counts and the predicted force set lacks the new force. This establishes a visible state transition, not the initiating command or its cause.
interpretation.cause: The initiating action, command queue, actor, and command acceptance are not recorded in these snapshots. A queued/external launch or an omitted deterministic launch rule remain hypotheses; neither is proven by the retained evidence.
interpretation.route_and_fuel: The raw force observation supplies the current visible segment source/destination, unit vector, progress, and acceleration. It does not establish the terminal route before launch; launch_ms is marked UNKNOWN in the observation schema, and no independent pre-action fuel input is retained. Do not infer route continuation, arrival, fuel, or success.
interpretation.queue: After birth the visible force contributes to the observed per-destination force ordering. No pre-action command queue or independent queue input is present, so this is an observed post-state queue membership difference only.
interpretation.limits: All 13 remain intermediate mismatches. The two historical matched trajectories remain untouched. This audit does not establish M2PASS.
